root_cause.text: An optimization in the DRM/XE driver skipped the GuC suspend operation for idle exec queues, which prevented the GPU from performing the context switch that flushes TLB entries for invalidated userptr VMAs, causing missed TLB invalidation and potential page faults in LR/preempt-fence VM mode.
root_cause.evidence: The CVE description and commit message state: "The idle-skip optimization bypasses GuC suspend, so the GPU may not perform the context switch that flushes TLB entries for invalidated userptr VMAs. In LR/preempt-fence VM mode, this can lead to missed TLB invalidation and page faults during userptr invalidation tests." The patch reverts the offending commit, restoring unconditional schedule toggling on suspend.

intent_record.intent_summary: Remove unused or relocated inline function `xe_exec_queue_idle_skip_suspend` from the public header.
intent_record.what: Removed the static inline function `xe_exec_queue_idle_skip_suspend` and its kernel-doc comment from the header file.
intent_record.how: The function definition is no longer available for compilation; any existing callers must be updated or removed to avoid compilation errors.

intent_record.intent_summary: Remove the unused or deprecated exec queue state flag EXEC_QUEUE_STATE_IDLE_SKIP_SUSPEND to simplify the state definitions.
intent_record.what: Removed the definition of the macro EXEC_QUEUE_STATE_IDLE_SKIP_SUSPEND (bit 11) from the exec_queue state flags.
intent_record.how: The macro is no longer available; any code referencing this flag will fail to compile or will have its behavior altered if the flag was used at runtime.

intent_record.intent_summary: Remove unused static helper functions for managing idle skip suspend state on GuC execution queues.
intent_record.what: Removed three static helper functions: exec_queue_idle_skip_suspend, set_exec_queue_idle_skip_suspend, clear_exec_queue_idle_skip_suspend, which manipulated the EXEC_QUEUE_STATE_IDLE_SKIP_SUSPEND flag on the GuC execution queue atomic state.
intent_record.how: The removal eliminates the ability to query, set, or clear the idle skip suspend flag, effectively deleting the associated mechanism that allowed execution queues to skip suspension when idle. Callers may be removed elsewhere or the feature is no longer needed.

intent_record.intent_summary: Remove incorrect idle/suspend check that could skip necessary ring tail update during replay submission.
intent_record.what: Changed the condition for setting the ring tail in non-parallel queue submission from being guarded by '!exec_queue_idle_skip_suspend(q)' to an unconditional else branch.
intent_record.how: Now, for non-parallel queues, the ring tail is always set when the outer condition '!job->restore_replay || job->last_replay' is true, whereas previously it was only set if the queue was not idle/suspend skipping.

intent_record.intent_summary: Remove the idle-skip-suspend check to ensure that suspend processing is not incorrectly bypassed for idle queues.
intent_record.what: Removed the local variable `idle_skip_suspend` and its usage in the condition of `__guc_exec_queue_process_msg_suspend`, so the `!idle_skip_suspend` check is no longer present.
intent_record.how: Previously, if `xe_exec_queue_idle_skip_suspend` returned true, the suspend logic was skipped entirely. Now, the condition no longer includes that check, so the suspend process will proceed even if the queue is idle (subject to the other remaining conditions).

intent_record.intent_summary: Fix suspend path by always marking the queue as suspended and signaling the fence, removing an unnecessary conditional that may have caused incorrect suspension behavior, and delete the unused sched_context function.
intent_record.what: In __guc_exec_queue_process_msg_suspend, the conditional call to set_exec_queue_idle_skip_suspend(q) based on idle_skip_suspend is removed, leaving only set_exec_queue_suspended(q) and suspend_fence_signal(q). Additionally, the static function sched_context is entirely deleted.
intent_record.how: The runtime behavior changes: previously, if idle_skip_suspend was true, the queue would be set to idle skip suspend before marking it suspended and signaling the fence; now the idle skip suspend step is omitted. The removal of sched_context eliminates an unused function, so there is no behavioral impact unless it was called elsewhere, but it appears to be dead code.

intent_record.intent_summary: Remove incorrect or unnecessary handling of idle_skip_suspend flag during GPU execution queue resume to prevent potential state corruption or redundant operations.
intent_record.what: Removed three code blocks that handled the exec_queue_idle_skip_suspend flag in __guc_exec_queue_process_msg_resume: adjusted ring tail and cleared flag when queue disabled, cleared flag and called sched_context when queue enabled, and cleared flag in the else branch.
intent_record.how: The function no longer checks or clears the idle_skip_suspend flag during resume, eliminating the associated ring tail adjustment and scheduling actions. This changes the resume behavior for queues that were marked as idle-skip-suspended.

intent_record.intent_summary: Remove the idle skip suspend optimization for faulting LR queues to ensure consistent suspension and resume behavior, and to avoid potential race conditions or incomplete state transitions.
intent_record.what: Removed local variable `idle_skip_suspend`, its assignment from `xe_exec_queue_idle_skip_suspend(q)`, the conditional block that incremented a skip counter when true, and the conditional assignment to `need_resume`. Simplified the condition for returning -EAGAIN from `!idle_skip_suspend && has_deps` to just `has_deps`. Set `need_resume = true` unconditionally.
intent_record.how: All faulting LR queues are now suspended without checking idle status, and `need_resume` is always set to true. The early return -EAGAIN occurs for any queue with dependencies, regardless of idle skip. The skip counter is no longer incremented.

candidates.rationale: This inline function defines the condition that marks an idle, non-parallel exec queue as eligible to skip suspend, directly implementing the optimization that causes the vulnerability.
Computes the idle skip flag, which is then used in the conditional below to bypass the actual GuC suspend operation (disable_scheduling) that would trigger a context switch and TLB flush.
This condition directly skips the disable_scheduling call and associated context switch when idle_skip_suspend is true, preventing the TLB invalidation needed after userptr invalidation.

vuln_statements.explanation: Computes the idle skip flag, which directly enables skipping the GuC suspend operation that would trigger a context switch and flush TLB entries.
Conditionally bypasses the disable_scheduling call (GuC suspend) when idle_skip_suspend is true, preventing the context switch needed for TLB invalidation after userptr invalidation.
Defines the condition that marks an idle, non-parallel exec queue as eligible to skip suspend, directly implementing the optimization that causes the vulnerability.
